scope: Leading classical D=0, flat local microphysics; full Cartesian 3D. Finite perturbation family and finite observation interval, not all-perturbation or eternal stability.
pilot_disclosure: Development pilots T=3 or 6 only, U(1), tangent finite differences, rectangular indexing and throughput; no T>6 object outcome inspected before this freeze.

criteria.single_retention: Every sampled tau=120..160: dominant R12 ball Q >= .90 initial total Q; local E/abs(Q)<1; one dominant 2%-of-peak connected component at endpoint. Report R8 and 5/10% sensitivity.
criteria.pair_retention: Every sampled tau=120..160: two disjoint R12 balls contain >= .90 initial total Q in sum and each >= .15 initial total Q. Report each laboratory E/Q; this is sufficient but not necessary for binding.
criteria.spatial_convergence: Report actual three-grid differences, inferred order where meaningful, finest change <= 2% of initial total Q for late core charges and <=5% for phase-space tangent norm/initial norm. Require decreasing differences; no pass for nonmonotonic unresolved sequences.
criteria.symmetry: R36 canonical translation and rotation tangent residual relative to instantaneous generator: report every grid/time, seek decreasing O(h^2) residual. Never demand a symmetry tangent have constant positive norm. Full event rotation .3 rad must approach same core charges on refinement.
criteria.boundary_time: Larger box and halved timestep changes < 1% initial Q in late core charge and <5% for normalized relative-shift tangent norm; otherwise continuum conclusion limited.
criteria.conservation: max relative total Q error <1e-9 and Hamiltonian drift <1e-3. Boundary is conservative fixed vacuum, no sponge.
criteria.production: Periodic mixed branch F=.5,S=sqrt(.75),Omega=sqrt(.775), zero-mean fully 3D perturbations, Qbar/volume exactly .25 sqrt(.775); count endpoint components at thresholds .02,.05,.10. Fragmentation does not certify a frozen cosmological mass function.

empirical_point.primordial_charge_yield: YQ=YB inferred from D+3nu BBN, not fitted to Planck dark density; an additional initial-state postulate.
empirical_point.entropy: No later SM entropy injection; hidden U1 exact in adopted EFT.
empirical_point.observable: Lower bound on present hidden matter omega=Omega h^2, compared with Planck 2018 TT,TE,EE+lowE+lensing base-LambdaCDM omega_c.
empirical_point.blindness: Published target already known; held out from parameter calibration, not an unseen/blind or prospective prediction.
